purpose: Stage-2 informational paired claim-validation baseline: does LCI's answer hold up? Both arms adjudicate the same structured claims over the pinned corpora and are scored against the independent, schema-versioned claim oracle. Observations only; not a merge gate.

harness.system_prompt: You are exploring an unfamiliar code checkout to answer a question about where specific behaviour lives. Ground every claim in a concrete file and location you found in THIS checkout; do not answer from prior memory of any upstream project. Conclude with the answer the question asks for.
harness.claim_answer_instruction: Return one JSON object {verdict: true|false|unsupported, evidence: [{path, line}], rationale}; cite only files in the checkout.

scorer.primary_metric: verdict accuracy and grounded-verdict accuracy vs the independent, forged-coordinate oracle; citation precision/recall/F1
scorer.judge: none (no LLM judge; deterministic verdict + evidence-anchor scoring)

subject_binary.name: lci
subject_binary.invocation: lci mcp (stdio), registered as server 'lci' via --mcp-config

treatment.description: LCI MCP semantic-navigation tools + Read; answers structured claims

baseline.description: Lexical Grep + Glob + Read only; no LCI server attached

model.note: Harness default (exploration_runner.DEFAULT_MODEL). Arm-shared for BOTH arms; the only manipulated variable across arms is the tool surface.

repetitions.note: Stage-2 pins reps=1 to match stage-1. Variance-powered replication (>=3 seeds, spread, significance) is explicitly deferred to a later task.

budget.note: A spending cap was never set because no paid run was authorized (see approval).

approval.reason: This stage-2 configuration was pinned by an unattended implementer session. A paid Claude CLI claim grid requires an explicit user-approved model and spending/time budget recorded before launch; no approver was present and no provider credentials are configured on this host (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN unset). Per design-unbiased-benchmarks stop conditions, an unapproved/uncapable paid grid must not be launched or its auth failures scored as answers.

execution.reason: paid_run_approval_not_granted; provider credentials not configured on this host
execution.smoke: hermetic one-claim/two-arm claim smoke passes via a deterministic fake agent through runner.run.run_task_both_arms (mode=claim-validation); the guarded live claim-smoke SKIPS without --live / credentials, proving the launch gate refuses an unapproved paid run
execution.omission_policy: Every planned (task, arm, rep) cell is present in run-records.jsonl with a machine-readable status; none were silently dropped.

shared: task bank (same 30 exploration tasks, same corpora / seed 7 / forge_version 1 pins)
both arm tool-allowlists and the Bash/Edit/Write denial
model claude-sonnet-4-5 (arm-shared), reps=1, time budget 600 s/cell
differs: prompt format: claim-request-v1 -> structured claim answer (claim_validation_answer_v1)

scorer: cited-evidence P/R/F1 vs an answer key (stage 1) -> verdict accuracy + grounded-verdict accuracy + false-premise/unsupported detection against the independent forged-coordinate oracle (stage 2)
headline: evidence-location quality (stage 1) -> answer correctness given location (stage 2)
comparability_with_stage1.limitation: Both stages are single-seed (seed 7, reps=1) and both were pinned-not-executed with $0 provider spend, so neither yields a measured LCI-vs-baseline delta; stage-2 numbers are directly comparable to stage-1 only as 'instrument pinned, grid not run', never as an effect size.

out_of_scope: threshold selection / merge gates on LCI-vs-baseline verdict or grounding deltas
